story_overview: On a bleak, windy beach, Chloe and Simone have a tense conversation. Later, the women are seen in their respective creative spaces: Kira studies a fashion mood board, while Simone writes in a journal and works on a screenplay titled 'Night and Dark,' which features a gothic apothecary.

video_prompts:
Chloe: Woman with dark hair wearing a green puffer jacket with a fur-lined hood and a green scarf.
Simone: Woman with a dark bob haircut and bangs, wearing a dark green jacket over a red patterned sweater.
Ruin Beach: A spacious and desolate coastal landscape composed of a wide sandy beach, a grassy hill, crumbling stone ruins, and the open sea.

In the windy, overcast Ruin Beach, Chloe, wearing the green puffer jacket, and Simone stand side-by-side on the beach. The wind blows through Chloe's hair as she gazes pensively out toward the sea. Simone turns her head slightly and speaks to Chloe.

Kira: Woman with short pink hair, wearing glasses, a black and pink athletic jacket, and patterned leggings.

From behind, Chloe and Kira sit side-by-side on a sandy, seaweed-covered beach in Ruin Beach, looking out at the vast, choppy ocean under a heavy, grey, overcast sky. Kira turns her head slightly to say something to Chloe.

At Ruin Beach, Simone and Chloe stand together. Simone talks while Chloe, wearing the green puffer jacket, looks away from her with a serious expression. It is windy, and Chloe's hair blows in the wind under an overcast sky.

Medium close-up of Simone and Chloe standing on the beach in Ruin Beach on an overcast day. Simone speaks with a serious expression while Chloe, wearing the green puffer jacket, listens intently. Crumbling stone ruins are visible on a grassy hill in the background.
In the windy Ruin Beach, Simone talks to Chloe. Chloe, wearing the green puffer jacket, listens with a pensive expression as her hair blows in the breeze.
Chloe, wearing the green puffer jacket, lets out a sigh, her expression turning sad and worried. Simone, standing beside Chloe, looks over at her with concern. The sky is overcast.

Close-up in Ruin Beach on a windy, overcast day. Kira, wearing the pink and black athletic jacket, looks off-camera as the wind blows her hair, her expression shifting into a slight smile. Chloe, wearing the green puffer jacket, and Simone stand next to her, partially visible in the frame.

Maya: Woman with long dark hair.
the wet seaweed: A tangled mass of dark, wet seaweed.

Maya leans in closer to get a better look at a decaying animal carcass resting on a tangled pile of wet seaweed. She gazes at the section of its exposed spine, revealing clean, white vertebrae.

video_prompts:
The Designer's Studio: Bedroom featuring a windowsill with a decorative lantern and a bird figurine, a wall displaying a pencil sketch of a dress, a detailed fashion mood board covered in sketches and photos, and several candles.
the white decorative lantern: Hexagonal decorative lantern made of distressed white-painted metal with clear glass panels, a vented conical roof, and a small metal loop on top.
the fashion mood board: A fashion mood board covered in a dense collage of pencil sketches of dress designs and various fashion photographs.
the pillar candles: Simple off-white wax pillar candles of varying heights, some with visible drips of melted wax down their sides, topped with small, flickering yellow-orange flames.

Medium shot panning right across The Designer's Studio. The shot glides past the white decorative lantern on a windowsill, settling on Kira as she stands intently studying the fashion mood board on the wall, tilting her head slightly. Several lit candles, the pillar candles, flicker on a surface next to her.

the tufted gray bed: Queen-size bed with a tall, button-tufted, light gray fabric headboard, dressed with a rumpled, fluffy white duvet cover and a pile of pillows including standard sleeping pillows and decorative ones in blush pink velvet and charcoal gray knit textures.
the dark journal: Hardcover journal with a dark, textured cover, an elastic closure strap, and cream-colored pages.
the vintage stereo system: 1990s-era compact stereo system with a matte black plastic central unit featuring a CD player and cassette deck below a red digital display, and two detachable box speakers with black cloth grilles.
A smooth pan across the warmly lit The Designer's Studio at night, moving past the fashion mood board, the vintage stereo system, and several of the pillar candles. The view settles on Simone sitting up in the tufted gray bed, intently focused on writing in the dark journal.

the flower string lights: String of decorative lights on a thin wire, with each individual light housed in a small, glowing, flower-shaped casing.
the white nightstand: A small, white-painted wooden nightstand with a single drawer, a simple round knob, and slightly distressed edges.
Medium shot of Simone, wearing the dark green jacket, sitting on the tufted gray bed in The Designer's Studio at night. The headboard of the tufted gray bed is decorated with the flower string lights. Simone looks pensive as she writes in the dark journal. She closes the dark journal and reaches just out of frame toward the white nightstand.
